title: About Me
paragraphs: Richard (or Chad) Bandol is a Philippine based frontend engineer since 2017, building elegant, high-performing, and user-focused web applications for startups and enterprise platforms. Skilled in ReactJS, NextJS, Vue.js, Nuxt, TailwindCSS, Redux Toolkit, Pinia, and headless CMS platforms such as Sanity, DatoCMS, Contentful, and Strapi.

Turns Figma and Adobe XD designs into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces, and has mentored junior developers, led teams as Team Lead, and worked in Agile sprints. Freelancing since April 2023, building marketing sites and immersive UI/UX with GSAP animations, TailwindCSS, and Styled Components.
